structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Governed data access and scalable compute are enabling constraints for enterprise analytics and AI deployment.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Data/AI demand is durable across scenarios, but consumption pricing makes realized revenue sensitive to optimization and workload placement.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Governance and platform integration can create persistence, but credible warehouse/lakehouse and hyperscaler substitutes remain.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI workload adoption
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Broad account-level AI usage suggests AI is becoming a platform workload rather than only a narrative adjacency.

discovery-weak-signals.name: contracted demand
discovery-weak-signals.basis: RPO growth exceeded current product-revenue growth, supporting forward demand visibility.

discovery-weak-signals.name: agentic governance expansion
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Natoma and partner integrations extend Snowflake from data governance toward governed agent actions.

discovery-weak-signals.name: supplyChainResilience
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Large multi-year AI-service and cloud-infrastructure commitments secure capacity access but create material fixed purchase obligations if consumption or workload economics underperform.

discovery-weak-signals.name: crossDivisionLeverage
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Committed AI-service and cloud capacity can support expansion of Snowflake's AI workloads across the platform, while dependence on third-party infrastructure/providers remains economically material.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: AI usage is broad but incremental AI revenue is not separately disclosed.

adversarial-red-team.name: sourceDependence
adversarial-red-team.basis: Current packet evidence is concentrated in one issuer-origin quarterly-results surface.

adversarial-red-team.name: competitiveResponse
adversarial-red-team.basis: Hyperscalers and competing data platforms can bundle or substitute adjacent data/AI capabilities.

expectations-execution.name: growth execution
expectations-execution.basis: Product revenue, customer expansion and raised guidance support execution against growth expectations.

expectations-execution.name: operating leverage
expectations-execution.basis: Raised operating-margin guidance indicates management expects growth to convert into improved non-GAAP profitability.
